mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_definition(id, name, description, system_prompt, model_config, created_at, model_id) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{description}, #{systemPrompt}, #{modelConfig, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{modelId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, system_prompt, model_config, created_at, model_id FROM agent_definition WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}
